title: Property dispute — Lekki estate
description: The applicant acquired a parcel of land at Lekki Phase 1 in 2019 via a registered deed of assignment. Despite valid documentation, the opposing party has continued to encroach on the property.

title: Contract breach — vendor agreement
description: The vendor failed to deliver goods as agreed in the signed contract dated January 2026, causing significant financial loss to the applicant.

title: Employment termination appeal
description: The applicant was unlawfully dismissed without due process after 5 years of service. No notice period was given and severance was withheld.

title: Debt recovery — personal loan
description: A personal loan of ₦500,000 was given to the respondent in March 2025. The respondent has refused to repay despite multiple demands.

title: Land acquisition — Abuja FCT
description: The applicant's land was acquired without compensation by the FCTA for road construction. The applicant seeks fair compensation as guaranteed by law.
